title: Mānasaṃ
text: 1. Evam me sutam ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || || 2. Atha kho Māro pāpimā yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || || Antalikkhacaro pāso || yo-yam carati mānaso || tena taṃ bādhayissāmi || na me samaṇa mokkhasīti || || 3. Rūpā saddā rasā gandhā || poṭṭhabbā ca manoramā || ettha me vigato chando || nihato tvam asi antakā ti || || 4. Atha kho Māro pāpimā || pe || tatth-ev-antaradhāyīti || || [page 112] 112 MĀRA-SAṂYUTTA IV. [IV. 2. 6.
